_note: Three input configurations for the Apify ATS Hiring Signals actor (opensignals/ats-hiring-signals). Copy any block as the full actor input. Costs are pay-per-result — ~$1/1,000 results on the pricing page; Apify free plan = $5/mo credit, Starter $39/mo, Scale $199/mo.

C1_weekly_discovery._purpose: Monday 09:00 IST run. Broad title/hiring discovery across the actor's ~8,800-board directory (Common Crawl-derived). This IS the last-30-days + remote gate: postedWithinDays=30, locationFilter=remote, excludeStale=true drops 45+ day ghost/evergreen postings.

C2_strict_title_contract_probe._purpose: Contract-signal probe. Contract type is NOT a first-class field on these boards, so we match description text for contract terms. Treat matches as hints — verify the posting page before logging Employment_Type=Contract.

C3_stack_evidence_desc_mode._purpose: Per-account technical evidence pass. Run once at qualification time on boards of accounts that passed the role gate; copy tech_stack + top_technologies into the tracker Notes field for outreach personalization.
